name: Groq
billing: Groq has model-specific free limits and paid plans. Review the project’s quota, billing and spend limits before using a paid tier.

steps.title: Choose your Groq project
steps.body: Create an account or sign in to GroqCloud, then select the project for your application.

steps.title: Create a project API key
steps.body: Open the API key page linked from the official quickstart and create a separate key for this application. Store it privately on your own machine.

steps.title: Check model access and limits
steps.body: Choose an available text model and review the project’s model permissions, rate limits and billing.
